mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.75% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.75%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 470000 indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue growth prospects deteriorate, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 1200 and RSAFS < 470000.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shock regimes (CPIAUCSL > 240), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 signals reduced manufacturing output and inflationary pressures, triggering a sell-off as the Federal Reserve tightens policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 104.0 and CPIAUCSL > 240.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of housing starts (HOUST) below its 12-month moving average indicates weak residential construction and a slowing economy, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.75% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.75%.
